The PSNR in dB against the sharp disks, 160 by 160 pixels, blurred with the Gaussian PSF of sigma 2 and the reflect border, with Gaussian noise of sigma 5 from NumPy's default_rng with seed 7. The blurred image itself has 24.81 dB. All rows use 3 levels and 100 iterations. Lambda 0 is the data term alone, which raises the noise as it sharpens. Total variation restoration reaches 30.92 dB on the same image with its defaults, since the disks are flat shapes.
